title: Palantir graph connectivity and person-rationale repair pass
summary: Converted metadata-only and embedded endpoints into explicit relations across the 1789, Thiel, executive-branch, EO 14243 and Vulcan/OSC clusters.

data.research_question: Why are named people included, and how should the disconnected graph nodes be joined without overstating evidence?
data.method: Repository graph audit, canonical endpoint resolution, explicit relation emission, source refresh, counterevidence preservation and machine-readable inclusion rationale.
classification_rules: Roles and affiliations explain inclusion but do not establish misconduct.
Conditional financing is not closing or disbursement.
Investigative attribution remains attributed and contested until primary records resolve it.
Relation endpoints must be canonical string IDs.

findings.finding: Explicit edges now connect Buskirk, Malik and Donald Trump Jr. to the organizations that previously listed them only in metadata.
Thiel Capital, Kratsios, OSTP, Helberg, State and the executive branch now form traversable career-path chains.
EO 14243 now has explicit issuer and affected-branch relations.
1789 investment, Series A, OSC conditional commitment and the attributed Navarro request are explicitly connected with evidence boundaries.

workflow.next_action: Acquire the primary Vulcan process, closing and disbursement records.
